shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!**/.next/**'"' .; rg --files app src pages 2>/dev/null | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts lib/products.ts app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx tsconfig.json; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next-env.d.ts; git show HEAD:tsconfig.json; git show HEAD:next-env.d.ts; git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore; cat next.config.ts; cat app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx; cat lib/products.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; git status --short; git diff --stat; rg -n 'export const (instant|dynamic|dynamicParams|revalidate|fetchCache|runtime)' app next.config.ts lib || true"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; git status --short; git diff -- .gitignore next.config.ts lib/products.ts app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; git status --short; rg -n 'export const (instant|dynamic|dynamicParams|revalidate|fetchCache|runtime)' app next.config.ts lib || true"
